subtasks.title: Make TableMapComponent CH-safe: guard the relationship hop + add CH Hit map accessors
subtasks.approach: In app/Livewire/TableMapComponent.php::formatRecords(), stop unconditionally resolving `$this->relationship` on every record. Resolve it only when the record actually defines that relationship (guard via Model::isRelation()/relationLoaded/method_exists on the resolved model); otherwise map pins directly from the record. This removes the RelationNotFoundException thrown when the model is App\Clickhouse\Models\Hit (which has no `scans` relationship). Then add read-only accessors to app/Clickhouse/Models/Hit.php so a raw CH hit exposes the same fields the map pin reads: `us_state` (from scan_us_state), `vehicleImage` (scan_img from scan_guid, Plate type), and `vehicle` (year/make/model). (`ocr` and `address` already exist as raw columns; `latitude`/`longitude` accessors already exist.) TDD: pin the regression with a TableMapComponentTest case that dispatches load-records-for-map against a CH Hit model + relationship='scans' and asserts no throw + updateMapData dispatched with mapped pin data; keep the existing Scan/default-path cases green.
subtasks.intended_diffs: TableMapComponent::formatRecords -> conditionally map relationship: `->map(fn ($record) => ($this->relationship && $record->isRelation($this->relationship)) ? $record->{$this->relationship} : $record)`. CH Hit: add usState()/vehicleImage()/vehicle() Attribute accessors mirroring how HitsResource/blade derive them. Test: add clickhouse-hit map case.
